title: A multilingual receipt
description:
Print the same receipt correctly for several countries.

```
en-GB: 20 Nov 2026   Coffee £3.50   1,250 points
de-DE: 20.11.2026    Coffee 3,50 €  1.250 Punkte
fr-FR: 20 nov. 2026  Coffee 3,50 €  1 250 points
names sorted for fr-FR: Anne, Émile, Eve, Zoé
```
hints: Format for people with their locale, and write the copy for programs with `Locale.ROOT` (lesson 8.05).
`Collator.getInstance(locale)` is a `Comparator` you can pass to `sort`.
requirements: Texts from a small `Map<Locale, Map<String, String>>` of translations.
A `Collator` to sort the customer names for each locale; save a machine-readable copy with `Locale.ROOT`.
stretch: Right-align the columns by code points, so names with accents and emoji still line up.
